author: jeeves_ny
caption: Laundry detergent sheets are a scam and this is why. A single laundry sheet is just 4 grams of detergent (half of which is PVA plastic binder), when a large load needs at least 24 grams. You'd need 6 laundry sheets to hit the correct minimum dose... Laundry sheet companies took the "we're selling you water" complaint about liquid detergent and flipped it into "we're selling you air and plastic", dressed up in a cardboard box and marketed as the sustainable choice.  They have the solution (give you more product) and refuse to use it just to protect their margins. That's not disrupting an industry. That's greenwashing greed.  #LaundryTok #Greenwashing #SustainabilityMyth
